title: Customer search

tickets.title: Search API
tickets.outcome: Authorized users can query matching customers through a stable API.
scope: Deliver the agreed behavior using existing application patterns.
acceptance: The user can complete this outcome with the agreed authorization rules.
verification: Exercise the expected behavior and an important failure case.
tickets.understanding: Understand the behavior, affected boundaries, and evidence needed to accept the result.
tickets.sizeRationale: Week: establish the API contract, authorization, queries, and behavioral checks, including review and merge.

tickets.title: Export filtered results
tickets.outcome: Users can download every matching customer as a CSV from the filtered results view.
scope: Export all matching results, not only the current page.
acceptance: The download preserves the selected filters.
Empty results produce a valid CSV with headers.
verification: Compare exported rows with an independently specified filtered fixture.
Verify that a current-page-only implementation fails that comparison.
tickets.understanding: How UI filters reach the export API and how failures are shown without losing the current search.
decisions: The export covers the full filtered result set for reconciliation.
tickets.sizeRationale: Day: reuse the completed export API and existing download UI, with time for filter/error verification, review, and merge.
